questions.question: A queue has 39 people. A volunteer marks the 15th person from each end. What is the sum of the two marked persons’ ranks from the front?
questions.explanation: The front ranks are 15 and 39 - 15 + 1 = 25; their sum is 40.

questions.question: Nimrat and Om exchange positions in a fixed row. Nimrat’s left rank changes from 13 to 27. By how much does Om’s right rank increase?
questions.explanation: Om moves from left 27 to left 13, so his right rank increases by 27 - 13 = 14.

questions.question: A is 14th from the left and B is 16th from the right. There are 2 people between them. How many different total strengths are possible?
questions.explanation: B can occupy left rank 11 or 17, giving valid totals 26 and 32. Hence 2 totals are possible.

questions.question: In a row of 48, Harjit occupies the left central seat. Lavish is 9th from the right. How many people sit strictly between them?
questions.explanation: Harjit is left 24 and Lavish is left 40. Between = 40 - 24 - 1 = 15.

questions.question: K weighs more than both L and M. N weighs less than M. Which comparison is definitely established?
questions.explanation: K > M and M > N give K > N. L’s relation to M and N is not fixed.

questions.question: Of 60 candidates, Hina is 19th. Only the top 35 qualify. What is Hina’s rank from the bottom among qualifiers?
questions.explanation: Use the selected total, 35: bottom rank = 35 - 19 + 1 = 17.

questions.question: Rows A and B contain 16 and 19 people respectively. Both are counted from the same left side. They merge by taking A1, B1, A2, B2 and so on; after A ends, remaining B members follow. What is the final front rank of the person originally 3rd from the right in B?
questions.explanation: The person is B17. The first 16 pairs occupy 32 places, so B17 occupies place 33.

questions.question: A film begins at 19:42. Its first half lasts 68 minutes, the interval lasts 17 minutes, and the second half lasts 74 minutes. When does it end?
questions.explanation: Total duration = 68 + 17 + 74 = 159 minutes, or 2 hours 39 minutes. Add this to 19:42 to get 22:21.

questions.question: An exam is 17 days after a Monday orientation. On which weekday is the exam?
questions.explanation: 17 mod 7 = 3; Monday + 3 days = Thursday.

questions.question: Aman and Bala reach the same appointment 32 minutes apart. Aman is 13 minutes early and Bala is late. How late is Bala?
questions.explanation: Arrival gap = early amount + late amount. Bala’s delay = 32 - 13 = 19 minutes.

questions.question: Four cards P, Q, R, S occupy places 4, 11, 20, 29 from the left. Swap P-Q, then R-S, then Q-S, then P-R. Which card finishes at place 4?
questions.explanation: After P-Q, place 4 holds Q. R-S does not affect it; Q-S puts S there, and P-R leaves it unchanged.

questions.question: A mixed queue has 17 boys. A girl is 15th from the front, with 6 girls ahead of her. How many boys stand behind her?
questions.explanation: Boys ahead = 14 - 6 = 8. Boys behind = 17 - 8 = 9.

questions.question: A digital clock is fixed at 7 minutes fast. At actual 23:56 on Monday, what does it display?
questions.explanation: Adding 7 minutes crosses midnight: Monday 23:56 becomes Tuesday 00:03.

questions.question: A book’s rank from the left is three times its rank from the right. There are 47 books on the shelf. What is its left rank?
questions.explanation: L + R = 48 and L = 3R. Hence R = 12 and L = 36.

questions.question: A clock gains 6 minutes during every 2 hours shown by that clock. It is correct at actual 08:00. When it shows 12:00, what is the actual time?
questions.explanation: Each 120 displayed minutes represents 114 true minutes. For 240 displayed minutes, true elapsed = 228 minutes, so actual time is 11:48.

questions.question: 5 students have distinct marks. J scored above K and L; M scored below K but above L; N scored below L. Which statement must be false?
questions.explanation: The forced order is J > K > M > L > N. N cannot be above K.

questions.question: A security shift runs from 23:25 to 01:10 the next day. How many minutes does it last?
questions.explanation: 35 minutes to midnight plus 70 minutes after midnight gives 105 minutes.

questions.question: In a 57-person queue, 10 people precede A and 16 follow B. C is one-third of the positional distance from A towards B. How many people stand between A and C?
questions.explanation: A is 11th and B is 41st, a separation of 30 positions. C is at 11 + 30/3 = 21, leaving 21 - 11 - 1 = 9 between A and C.

questions.question: X is 23rd from the left, Y is 8th from the right, and exactly 9 people separate them. Which is the complete set of possible totals?
questions.explanation: Y’s left rank could algebraically be 13 or 33, giving totals 20 or 40. Total 20 is invalid because X itself is 23rd; only 40 works.

questions.question: A and B swap places in a row of 37. Afterwards A is 12th from the left and B is 9th from the right. What was A’s original left rank?
questions.explanation: A’s original place is B’s final place: 37 - 9 + 1 = 29th from the left.

questions.question: In a queue of 40, Veer moves from 15th to 21st from the front. Which direction and how many places did he move?
questions.explanation: A larger front rank means moving backward: 21 - 15 = 6 places.

questions.question: A bus is scheduled for 15:20. It arrives 8 minutes late and leaves 6 minutes after arrival. P reaches the stop 5 minutes before the scheduled time. How long does P wait before departure?
questions.explanation: P arrives at 15:15 and the bus leaves at 15:34. Waiting time = 19 minutes.

questions.question: A list of 90 candidates has no ties. Every candidate at an original rank divisible by 3 withdraws. S was originally 47th. What is S’s new rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: 30 withdraw, leaving 60. Above S, 15 of the first 46 withdraw, so S becomes 32nd; bottom rank = 60 - 32 + 1 = 29.

questions.question: A shuttle leaves every 18 minutes from 07:10 onward. A passenger arrives at 08:03. How many minutes must she wait for the next departure?
questions.explanation: Departures are 07:10, 07:28, 07:46 and 08:04. The next one is 1 minute after 08:03.

questions.question: Two equal rows are aligned from a fixed left side. In Row I, A is left 7 and right 18. B sits opposite A in Row II; C sits 5 seats to B’s fixed right. The rows merge as I1, II1, I2, II2 and so on. What is C’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Each row has 7 + 18 - 1 = 24 people. C is II12, hence merged front rank 24; back rank = 48 - 24 + 1 = 25.
